question: Which of the following is considered a medicinal plant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neem.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neem** is considered a **medicinal plant** due to its numerous health benefits and **medicinal properties.**
 
• Neem has been used in **Ayurvedic medicine** for centuries to treat a wide range of ailments, including **skin disorders, fever, and digestive issues.**
 
• The **leaves, bark, and seeds** of the neem tree are all used in traditional medicine to make remedies for various health conditions.
 
• Neem contains active compounds like **azadirachtin, nimbin, and nimbidin**, which have** anti-inflammatory, antifungal, antibacterial, and antiviral** properties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sal** is a **hardwood tree** that is commonly found in** India **and other parts of Asia.

 
 
• It is used to make** furniture, railway sleepers,** and other products.
 
 
 
• **Teak** is a tropical hardwood tree that is native to **Southeast Asia**.
 
 
• It is highly valued for its **durability and water resistance,** and is commonly used in **boat-building, furniture-making, **and other applications.
 
 
 
• **Deodar **is a species of **cedar tree **that is native to the Himalayas.
 
 
• It is commonly used in **construction and for making furniture.**
